info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update P2m By Refund Id-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows you to update the payment status of a P2M transaction using a specific refund ID. Businesses can use this functionality to manage and adjust transactions associated with refunds effectively. The operation is crucial for financial reconciliation and ensuring accurate customer transactions. It is typically utilized by financial systems and support teams monitoring payment statuses and resolving discrepancies. Ensure to provide the correct refund ID to apply the update as intended.

patch.summary: Update refund details for a specific resource.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific refund associated with the given resource ID. Use this to modify refund properties such as amount, status, or metadata.
